rationale: For an all-day, data-heavy estimating tool, the UI must prioritize extreme legibility, reduce cognitive fatigue, and establish a clear data hierarchy. The recently approved header sets a 'Swiss/high-contrast' tone: function over decoration, restrained color, and crisp geometry.

P0: Implement cohesive typography scale (Inter + JetBrains Mono) to fix varied system fonts.
Refactor section header colors (remove rainbow backgrounds, use semantic left-borders).
Standardize base light/dark mode CSS tokens for background, text, and border layers.
P1: Align Tile/Toggle component states to the new monochrome ghost button aesthetic.
Implement right-alignment and tabular-nums for all KPI grids and Quote tables.
Standardize spacing scales (p-1, p-2, p-4) to maintain density while adding optical breathing room.
P2: Add sticky headers to the left-panel scrolling sections.
Implement subtle global focus rings for keyboard navigation.
Add unobtrusive 'auto-saving' micro-interactions to prevent layout shift.

primary_sans.rationale: Inter is engineered for UI clarity at small sizes. It reduces fatigue during all-day use compared to generic system fonts.

mono.rationale: Already established. Crucial for tabular data. MUST apply 'font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums' to prevent jittering when prices recalculate.

scale.--spot-text-sm: 13px / 1.4 lh (For Input Labels, Table Data, Sub-text)
scale.--spot-text-base: 14px / 1.5 lh (For Primary Form Inputs, Standard Text)
scale.--spot-text-xl: 20px to 24px / 1.2 lh / tracking-tighter (For KPI Numbers in right dashboard)

color.strategy: Eliminate 'rainbow' noise. Color is for function (status, warning, success), not decoration. The app must rely on structural grayscale with pinpoint color accents.

section_headers_fix.problem: Current section headers (Estimate Info, Bill of Materials, etc.) are too saturated, causing visual competition.
section_headers_fix.solution: Use a monochrome background (--spot-bg2) with a semantic 3px left-border accent instead of filling the entire header background. E.g., 'border-l-4 border-spot-blue'. Add subtle 1px bottom border (--spot-border).

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Respect the density. Estimators hate scrolling. Use micro-spacing.
layout_and_spacing.panel_separation: Replace heavy drop-shadows between the Left (Input) and Right (Cost Dashboard) panels with a crisp 1px solid border (--spot-border) and a subtle background shift (Left: --spot-bg2, Right: --spot-bg).
layout_and_spacing.kpi_grid: In the Economics/Cost Buildup section, use a 'Control Room' grid. 1px borders between cells (border-collapse look). Labels top-left (--spot-text-xs), values bottom-right (JetBrains Mono, text-lg).

tiles_pills_toggles.rationale: Moves away from saturated colors to a high-contrast binary state (neutral vs solid black/white).

badges_colored_dots.style: Adopt the 'Status Dot' pattern from the new header. Instead of a full green pill for 'In-Stock', use a neutral pill with a 6px '--spot-green' dot inside it. Reduces visual noise massively.

tables.style: Quote tables should use a 1px bottom border per row. Zebra striping only if rows > 5 (use --spot-bg3 for even rows). NO vertical borders.

general_usability.alignment: Strict right-alignment for ALL monetary and dimensional numbers. Left-alignment for text.
general_usability.focus_states: Every interactive element must have: `focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-spot-accent/30 focus:ring-offset-1`. Critical for keyboard power users.
general_usability.scrolling: Make Section Headers sticky (`sticky top-0 z-10 bg-spot-bg2`) so users never lose context deep within the Bill of Materials.
general_usability.feedback: Auto-save/calc feedback should NOT be a toast that covers UI. Use a subtle inline indicator in the draft bar (e.g., 'Saving...' -> 'Saved' in --spot-text3).
